title: Replication package for: Have Firms Become More Responsive to Returns? A Changing Capital-Adjustment Gradient in Japan
description: Code and public input data for the estimation of investment gradients among Japanese listed firms, FY1999-2024. The estimation sample is drawn from Nikkei NEEDS Financial QUEST and cannot be redistributed. A synthetic panel generator with known true coefficients is included so that the pipeline can be run and checked without a NEEDS licence.
